description: Grounding Music | Begin the Day Calm | 1.5 Hours of gentle Indian classical sitar to start your morning steady and clear.
Before the phone, before the rush — ninety minutes of warm, unhurried sitar in Raga Bilawal, the classical morning raga, to let your day begin on your terms.
🎧 HOW TO USE — play softly while you wake, stretch, make tea, or sit for a few quiet minutes. Gentle energy, nothing jarring.
⏱ BEST FOR — grounding practice · calm mornings · gentle focus · morning meditation · starting the day without noise
🎵 ABOUT — Raga Bilawal is the bright, open morning raga of Indian classical music — clear-eyed and warm, traditionally played as the day begins.
